user.title: Add a pension or policy account
user.description: This sets up one account. Add the integration again for each additional pension/policy. Start with the login page's URL and the CSS selector for something that only appears once you're logged in.

data.name: Account name
data.values_url: Page to read values from (optional, if different from the login page)
data.otp_selector: CSS selector for a one-time code prompt (optional)

login_step.title: Login step
login_step.description: Add one step at a time, in the order they should run. "fill" needs a selector and a value source; "click" needs a selector; "wait" waits for a selector to appear, or for a fixed number of milliseconds if you leave the selector blank.

data.value_source: Value source (fill only): credential / literal / env
data.credential_name: Credential name (if value source is credential)
data.literal_value: Literal value (if value source is literal)
data.env_var_name: Environment variable name (if value source is env)
data.wait_ms: Milliseconds to wait (wait only, if no selector)

field.title: Value to read
field.description: Add one field at a time. A label is matched against the page's visible text and the first amount after it is used; a selector reads one element's text directly.

credentials.title: Account credentials
credentials.description: Enter the credentials this account's login steps need. These are stored in Home Assistant's own config entry storage.

error.incomplete_login_step: That step is missing something it needs - a selector, or a value for the chosen value source.
error.incomplete_field: That field needs a label (if finding by label) or a selector (if finding by selector).

abort.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong building this account. Check the Home Assistant log for details.
